Name: Meadowdew Farm - A mini meadowland
Author: windvalley
Description:
[b] Overview[/b]

Adds a new farm type based on the meadowlands farm, but in a smaller and more manageable package. 

[b]Features[/b]

Similar to the meadowlands farm, it comes with: 
[list]
[*] Blue grass 
[*] 1 coop 
[*] 1 white chicken﻿
[*] Starting gift of 15 hay by default or 15 poultry feed if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]chicken feed - a poultry diet rework [/url]is installed 
[/list]
[b]Installation
 
 [/b]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]spacecore[/url]﻿. Download and then extract into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[b]
Mods Pictured
[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164?tab=description]Simple Foliage[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage - Unofficial Update for 1.6[/url]﻿
[/list][b]
Notes

[/b][list]
[*]This is the first map mod I've made, so while I hope everything works well, there may be some issues I didn't catch while testing. Let me know any problems you have, and I will try my best to figure out how to fix them.
[*]Due to how the meadowlands farm works, there is no option to replace it with this one. The coop and fence that spawn in have a fixed location, so they appear in odd and unreachable places on a smaller map.
[*]There is no starting fence around the coop on this map like there is in the meadowlands farm map. I could not figure out how to get it to appear.
[/list]
